Command replay (a class of call, not one reported incident)

Read a production .env file with cat: how to stop it

What happens

Read a production .env file with cat. The call below tries to read a credentials file. The agent sends it through its Bash tool, and it involves .env files.

The call

cat .env.production

Tool: Bash. The replay uses placeholder tokens and hosts only.

Fix it without us

Keep production secrets in the secret store of your host and only development values in .env files, and add deny rules such as Read(./.env) and Read(./.env.*) to the Claude Code settings. A Read rule also covers shell commands such as cat, but not a script that opens the file itself, so enable the Claude Code sandbox when the block must hold.

What KYA does

Replay result: Stopped. In the replay test, the local hook denies the call and names the rule.

Rule secret-read-shell, first stopped in version 0.32.8.

The hook is local and advisory. It fails open: if kya breaks or times out, the call goes ahead.

Install

For Claude Code, the host this replay ran on:

/plugin marketplace add The-Pixel-Boys/shield-kya
/plugin install kya@shield-kya

For any host:

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
